name: TrackMania Nations Forever / United Forever
author: theanton1998@gmail.com
description: Dedicated server for TrackMania Nations Forever / United Forever. Ports the archived Hoerli1337/pterodactyl-eggs TMNF-UF egg to the current Pelican egg schema, fixes the config-generation bug that ignored variable changes on restart, and reads the dedicated config through Pelican's built-in XML file parser instead of a hand-rolled heredoc.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt update
apt install -y ca-certificates curl unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

DEDICATED_URL="http://files2.trackmaniaforever.com/TrackmaniaServer_2011-02-21.zip"
TRACKLIST_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hoerli1337/pterodactyl-eggs/master/TMNF-UF/tracklist.txt"

echo "Downloading TrackMania Forever dedicated server..."
curl -sSL -o server.zip "${DEDICATED_URL}"
unzip -qo server.zip -d /mnt/server
rm server.zip
chmod 755 TrackmaniaServer

# Strip files that are useless on a headless dedicated server
rm -rf RemoteControlExamples CommandLine.html ListCallbacks.html ListMethods.html \
       manialink_dedicatedserver.txt Readme_Dedicated.html TrackmaniaServer.exe

# Keep the shipped default dedicated_cfg.txt in place - Pelican's config.files
# parser rewrites the relevant fields from the panel's environment variables on
# every server start, instead of the one-shot heredoc the old egg used (which
# silently ignored variable changes after the first boot).

mkdir -p GameData/Tracks/MatchSettings
echo "Downloading default tracklist..."
curl -sSL -o GameData/Tracks/MatchSettings/tracklist.txt "${TRACKLIST_URL}"

echo "~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~"
echo "TRACKMANIA SERVER INSTALLED"
echo "~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~"

variables.description: Last 3 characters of your premium player key. Leave empty for a plain TMNF/TMUF account without a key.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Comment shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Leave empty for a public server.

variables.name: Spectator Password
variables.description: Leave empty to allow free spectating.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Shared password for the SuperAdmin, Admin, and User authorization levels of the dedicated server (XML-RPC). Change this from the default before going public.

variables.name: Ladder Mode
variables.description: 0 = disabled, 1 = friendly, forced = ranked ladder play.

variables.name: Environment / Packmask
variables.description: 'stadium' for TrackMania Nations Forever. Leave empty, or use 'united'/'desert'/'island'/'rally'/'bay'/'coast'/'stadium' for TrackMania United Forever.

variables.name: P2P Port
variables.description: UDP port used for peer-to-peer map/skin distribution. Allocate an extra port on this server and put it here.

variables.name: XML-RPC Port
variables.description: Local control port for the dedicated server (used by server controllers such as XAseco/ManiaControl). Does not need to be exposed publicly.
